research.name: HexPatch
research.note: Terminal hex editor that disassembles binaries and lets you type assembly to patch them, showing the resulting bytes as you write.

effects: patch popup where typed assembly is shown as assembled bytes above the input, colored green, red and gray
hex grid with bytes colored by value class, zero bytes dimmed, beside a matching text view
side-by-side hex and disassembly view with symbol names inline
